name: What's the difference between a main sewer line clog and a floor drain clog?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a main sewer line clog and a floor drain clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: A floor drain clog affects only that specific drain, causing water to back up in that single location. A main sewer line clog, however, impacts multiple drains and fixtures throughout your home, often causing toilets to back up, multiple sinks to drain slowly, or sewage smells in various areas. A main line clog is a more serious issue that can lead to widespread backups if not addressed promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: A floor drain clog affects one drain, while a main sewer line clog impacts multiple drains and fixtures throughout your home, indicating a larger problem.
